rater: author (Nguyen Huu Tien) — bias risk noted
selection_rule: Coherence: same 10 page IDs 1,5,10,15,20,25,28,33,35,39 for A500/B/C. Grounding: all 5 test questions. Metadata: 5 test x top-3. Filter: questions with non-null filter.
preprocessing: normalize_text drops running headers (ECLECTIC SERIES / SIXTH READER), bare page numbers, soft hyphen line-breaks; keeps paragraph breaks.

strategy_A_fixed.note: Sentence-boundary snap reduced mid-sentence cuts vs naive fixed windows; still weaker on dense verse examples.

strategy_B_paragraph.note: Paragraph units keep examples intact; oversized paras use sentence windows.

metadata_usefulness.usefulness_note: section scopes voice/gesture/selection; limitation: page-range heuristic, not publisher TOC.

error_root_cause.symptom: Hit@3 fails or top-1 is neighboring thunderstorm page (37) instead of Thomson bio evidence on page 38.
error_root_cause.root_cause: Semantic near-duplicate: 'After the Thunderstorm' body (p37) and author blurb (p38) share storm/seasons vocabulary; MiniLM ranks narrative prose above the short bibliographic sentence containing gold quote 'This extract is from The Seasons.' Chunking is not the main failure—embedding confuses adjacent literary context.
error_root_cause.not_primary: Not mainly chunk_size: A1000 still ranks p37 first; cleaning headers did not remove the gold sentence.

error_root_cause.symptom: Gold page 39 often rank-2; Hit@1 misses 'latter end of May' whitewashing date.
error_root_cause.root_cause: House-cleaning narrative spans p39–41 with repeated wash/furniture imagery; dense narrative distractors outrank the short date clause. Evidence exists in top-3 for B/C (partial grounding) but not always Hit@1.
error_root_cause.not_primary: Filter section=selection correctly keeps scope on C but cannot separate intra-section neighbors.
